title: codemother's proofs find the trouble store through trouble's published tool
intention: cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_codemother.py _troubles_now (line 1087) imports store_root from cairn.devices.trouble.trouble, trouble's device code. It imports the same function from trouble's published store tool, cairn.devices.trouble.tools.store.store, instead.
why: Measured 2026-11-11: the build inspector filed inspector-new-finding-encapsulation-holds naming cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_codemother.py:1087 importing cairn.devices.trouble.trouble. RULE 1 and outline 2.3.7.1.3: outside trouble, the store is reached through the tool trouble publishes, and that tool offers store_root.
traces_to: CLAUDE.md RULE 1; outline 2.3.7.1.3 (trouble's published client tool is the exception to talking over the bus); outline 17.13.1.
how: One import line in cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_codemother.py:1087 becomes `from cairn.devices.trouble.tools.store.store import store_root`; new proof cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_codemother_reads_troubles_through_the_store.py, two teeth.

clauses.claim: the build inspector's encapsulation_holds finds no breach from a file under cairn/devices/codemother landing on cairn/devices/trouble
cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_codemother.py names no cairn.devices.trouble module but its published store tool

decisions.text: D1: same function, published door: store_root from cairn.devices.trouble.tools.store.store; nothing else in test_codemother.py changes.
